item.title: SHOOTING VICTIM DISCOVERED
item.description: Harris County Sheriff’s Office deputies responded to a complex at the 11300 block of Regency Green Drive, near Grant Road and Jones. Preliminary: Upon arrival, deputies found a deceased man with an apparent gunshot wound. One person is detained on-scene. CSI and Homicide detectives are responding. Sheriff Ed Gonzalez

item.title: Scam Uses Urgency and Official-Looking Messages to Target Victims
item.description: Authorities are warning residents nationwide about a growing scam in which criminals use convincing letters, emails, and text messages to pressure victims into making immediate payments using QR codes.
